title: Cloud Functions: triggers by HTTP, by event and by Pub/Sub

videos.script: A function is not a small server you upload. It is a handler you write, and Google wraps a server around it. This lesson runs that wrapper on your own computer. {{http}} First, an HTTP function. The shop needs a quote before checkout. Items go in, a total in cents comes out, and the function decides every status itself. {{event}} Then an event function. Nobody waits for its answer. It receives a CloudEvent, and its only reply is whether it succeeded. {{pubsub}} Then a Pub/Sub trigger, end to end. Nothing listens to the topic. A push subscription posts each message to the function, and you will watch it arrive. {{generations}} Last, the two generations of Cloud Functions. The second is built on Cloud Run, and that changes how many requests one copy can take.
